trans-unit.source: We need to get there without delay. His Highness awaits.
trans-unit.target: We need to get there without delay. His Highness awaits.

trans-unit.source: To be given a direct invitation by King Alvanista is very impressive.
trans-unit.target: To be given a direct invitation by the King of Alvanista is very impressive.

trans-unit.source: I believe I said “without delay.” Come on.
trans-unit.target: I believe I said “without delay.” Come on.
